scope: Single-host authenticated internal Pump-102 deployment candidate; checklist status is not production accreditation.

status_definitions.verified: Explicit inspection or recorded check establishes the stated limited scope.

status_definitions.missing: A completed implementation/evidence was not found in the inspected surface.
status_definitions.blocked: Requires external evidence or operator participation.
